privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: 원진성형외과의원 ("the Clinic") values and carefully handles users' personal information in providing its consultation reservation service, in compliance with applicable law. This policy explains the items, purposes, and retention period of the personal information processed by the Clinic.

sections.heading: 1. Personal Information We Collect
sections.body:
To process consultation reservation requests, the Clinic collects the following information.
Required: name, date of birth, gender, WeChat ID, preferred contact time
Automatically collected: referral information (ad source, referral code), IP address, service usage records

sections.heading: 2. Purpose of Collection and Use
sections.body:
Collected personal information is used only for the following purposes.
Receiving and confirming consultation/procedure reservation requests
Contacting you via WeChat for consultation through your assigned consultant
Managing reservation records and checking for duplicates or errors
Preventing fraudulent use and maintaining stable service operation
Improving the service by analyzing advertising referral sources

sections.heading: 3. Retention and Use Period
sections.body: In principle, the Clinic destroys personal information without delay once the purpose of collection and use has been achieved. Where retention is required under applicable law, the information is securely kept for the period required by law before being destroyed.

sections.heading: 4. Third-Party Disclosure and Outsourcing
sections.body: The Clinic does not provide users' personal information to external parties, in principle. The collected WeChat ID is used solely for your assigned consultant to contact you directly for consultation, and is not outsourced to any external processor.

sections.heading: 5. User Rights and How to Exercise Them
sections.body: Users may at any time request to view, correct, or delete their personal information. Such requests may be submitted through the contact information below, and the Clinic will act on legitimate requests without delay.

sections.heading: 6. Destruction Procedure and Method
sections.body: Personal information stored in electronic file form is permanently deleted using a technical method that prevents recovery. Personal information recorded or stored on paper is destroyed by shredding or incineration.

sections.heading: 7. Contact
sections.body:
For inquiries regarding the processing of personal information, please contact:
